{"kinds":[{"name":"NOR SR latch","description":"Two cross-coupled NOR gates that set or reset on active-high S and R inputs and keep one stored bit, Q, in the feedback loop while both inputs are low."},{"name":"NAND SR-bar latch","description":"Two cross-coupled NAND gates driven by active-low set and reset inputs that keep a single stored bit in their feedback loop while both inputs are high."},{"name":"Gated SR latch","description":"An SR latch whose set and reset inputs pass only while an enable level is asserted, so it keeps its stored bit whenever the enable is inactive."},{"name":"Set-dominant SR latch","description":"An SR latch with extra logic that resolves simultaneous set and reset in favor of set, and it holds one state bit."},{"name":"Reset-dominant SR latch","description":"An SR latch with extra logic that resolves simultaneous set and reset in favor of reset, and it holds one state bit."},{"name":"Gated D latch (active-high)","description":"A transparent latch that passes D to Q while the enable is high and freezes the last value in its storage node when the enable falls."},{"name":"Gated D latch (active-low)","description":"A transparent latch that passes D to Q while the enable is low and keeps the captured bit in its storage node while the enable is high."},{"name":"Gated JK latch","description":"A level-enabled latch whose J and K inputs set, reset or invert the stored bit while the enable is asserted, and it holds that bit otherwise."},{"name":"Earle latch","description":"A hazard-free two-level AND-OR latch with a redundant consensus term that holds its stored bit glitch-free across enable transitions."},{"name":"Polarity-hold latch","description":"A latch built from complementary data and clock paths that tracks the data while the clock is active and keeps one stored bit while the clock is inactive."},{"name":"Mux-feedback latch","description":"A 2:1 multiplexer whose output feeds back to one input, selecting new data while enabled and recirculating its single stored bit otherwise."},{"name":"Transmission-gate static latch","description":"A CMOS latch that uses a transmission gate to admit data during the enable phase and a gated back-to-back inverter loop to keep the bit statically."},{"name":"Dynamic latch","description":"A latch that samples data through a pass transistor onto a capacitive node and keeps the bit as stored charge only for a limited time after the enable closes."},{"name":"Latch with asynchronous clear","description":"A D latch with an overriding clear input that forces the stored bit to zero regardless of the enable, and it otherwise holds its single bit."},{"name":"Latch with asynchronous preset","description":"A D latch with an overriding preset input that forces the stored bit to one regardless of the enable, and it otherwise holds its single bit."},{"name":"Pulsed latch","description":"A transparent latch opened by a narrow pulse generated from a clock edge, so it captures data in a short window and holds one bit between pulses."},{"name":"Scan lockup latch","description":"A latch placed between scan segments in different clock domains that holds the shifted bit for half a cycle to prevent hold races during scan shift."},{"name":"LSSD shift-register latch","description":"A level-sensitive scan design latch pair in which an L1 latch with separate system and scan clocks feeds an L2 latch, and each latch keeps one bit."},{"name":"Dual-port latch","description":"A latch with two independently enabled data inputs that each write one shared stored bit, which it holds when neither enable is active."},{"name":"Muller C-element","description":"A state-holding gate whose output goes high when all inputs are high and low when all inputs are low, and it retains its previous output bit otherwise."},{"name":"Bus-keeper latch","description":"A weak feedback inverter pair attached to a tri-state bus that retains the last driven logic level as its stored bit when all drivers float."},{"name":"Tri-state output transparent latch","description":"A multi-bit transparent latch bank with a latch-enable and an independent output-enable that holds a captured bus word and can release its outputs to high impedance."},{"name":"Addressable latch","description":"A bank of individually addressed bit latches in which an address and data input update one selected bit while enabled, and every bit holds its own stored value."},{"name":"State-retention balloon latch","description":"An always-powered shadow latch that saves the bit of a power-gated register on a save signal, keeps it during power-down, and restores it on wake-up."},{"name":"Razor shadow latch","description":"A delayed-clock shadow latch beside a main storage element that recaptures late-arriving data and keeps that sampled bit for comparison with the main value."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Positive-edge D flip-flop","description":"Captures the D input into its single state bit Q on each rising clock edge and holds it until the next rising edge."},{"name":"Negative-edge D flip-flop","description":"Captures the D input into its single stored bit on each falling clock edge, holding the value through the following clock cycle."},{"name":"D flip-flop with asynchronous reset","description":"Stores one bit sampled from D on the clock edge, and forces that bit to zero immediately whenever its reset input is asserted, independent of the clock."},{"name":"D flip-flop with synchronous reset","description":"Stores one bit that is loaded from D on each clock edge, or loaded with zero on the clock edge when the reset input is asserted."},{"name":"D flip-flop with asynchronous preset and clear","description":"Keeps one state bit loaded from D on the clock edge, which can also be forced high by an asynchronous preset input or low by an asynchronous clear input."},{"name":"Clock-enable D flip-flop","description":"Holds one stored bit that is updated from D on a clock edge only when its enable input is high, and otherwise recirculates its current value."},{"name":"JK flip-flop","description":"Keeps one state bit that on each clock edge holds, sets, resets, or toggles according to the J and K inputs."},{"name":"T flip-flop","description":"Keeps one state bit that inverts on each clock edge when the T input is high and holds its value otherwise."},{"name":"Clocked SR flip-flop","description":"Keeps one state bit that is set by the S input or cleared by the R input, with changes taking effect only on the active clock edge."},{"name":"Set-dominant SR flip-flop","description":"Stores one bit updated on the clock edge from set and reset inputs, choosing to set the bit when both inputs are asserted together."},{"name":"Reset-dominant SR flip-flop","description":"Stores one bit updated on the clock edge from set and reset inputs, choosing to clear the bit when both inputs are asserted together."},{"name":"Dual-edge-triggered flip-flop","description":"Samples its D input into one stored output bit on both rising and falling clock edges, using two internal latches whose outputs are multiplexed by the clock level."},{"name":"Master-slave D flip-flop","description":"Builds edge-triggered storage from a master latch that is transparent in one clock phase and a slave latch transparent in the other, each holding one internal bit."},{"name":"Pulse-triggered flip-flop","description":"Uses a short pulse generated from the clock edge to briefly open a single latch, which then holds the captured D bit for the rest of the cycle."},{"name":"Sense-amplifier flip-flop","description":"Resolves the differential D input with a precharged sense-amplifier stage at the clock edge and keeps the result in a following set-reset latch."},{"name":"Complementary-output D flip-flop","description":"Stores one bit captured from D on the clock edge and drives both the true output Q and its inverted output Qn from that stored state."},{"name":"Muxed-input D flip-flop","description":"Selects between two data inputs with a select line and captures the chosen bit into its single state register on the clock edge."},{"name":"State-retention flip-flop","description":"Holds a normal one-bit register plus an always-powered balloon latch that saves the bit before power-down and restores it on wake-up."},{"name":"Razor timing-error flip-flop","description":"Captures D into a main flop on the clock edge and again into a delayed-clock shadow latch, raising an error flag register when the two captured bits disagree."},{"name":"DICE radiation-hardened flip-flop","description":"Stores one bit redundantly across four interlocked storage nodes so that a transient upset on a single node is restored by the others."},{"name":"Metastability-hardened flip-flop","description":"Captures one asynchronous input bit on the clock edge using a high-gain, fast-resolving storage cell designed to settle quickly from metastable states."},{"name":"Sticky-bit flip-flop","description":"Keeps one status bit that is set on the clock edge whenever an event input fires and stays set until an explicit clear input is applied."},{"name":"Write-1-to-clear flip-flop","description":"Holds one status bit set by a hardware event input and cleared on the clock edge when software writes a one to its bit position."},{"name":"Write-1-to-toggle flip-flop","description":"Holds one control bit that inverts on the clock edge whenever a register write delivers a one to its bit position and otherwise keeps its value."},{"name":"Event-clocked capture flip-flop","description":"Uses an asynchronous event signal as its clock so that the rising edge of the event latches a one or a data bit into its single stored bit until reset."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Load-enable parallel register","description":"Captures an N-bit input word in parallel on a clock edge when its load enable is asserted, and otherwise keeps its stored word in a bank of D flip-flops."},{"name":"Synchronous-reset register","description":"Stores an N-bit word in flip-flops that are forced to a configured reset value on the clock edge when a synchronous reset input is active, and loads new data otherwise."},{"name":"Asynchronous-reset register","description":"Holds an N-bit word in flip-flops that return to their reset value as soon as an asynchronous reset is asserted, without waiting for a clock edge."},{"name":"Parallel-in serial-out shift register","description":"Loads a full word in parallel and then shifts it out one bit per clock on a serial output, keeping the partly shifted word in its flip-flop chain."},{"name":"Serial-in serial-out delay register","description":"Passes a serial bit stream through a chain of flip-flops so that each bit comes out a fixed number of cycles later, keeping the in-transit bits as its state."},{"name":"Circular rotate register","description":"Rotates its stored word left or right by one position per enabled clock, feeding the bit that falls off one end back into the other, and keeps the current rotated word."},{"name":"Byte-enable register","description":"Stores a multi-byte word and updates only the bytes whose write-strobe bits are set during a write, keeping the other bytes unchanged."},{"name":"Write-one-to-clear status register","description":"Holds status bits that hardware events set and that software clears by writing a 1 to the matching bit positions."},{"name":"Write-one-to-set register","description":"Keeps a word of control bits in which a software write of 1 sets the matching bits, while writes of 0 leave those bits as they are."},{"name":"Read-to-clear register","description":"Accumulates event bits or a count in flip-flops and returns its contents on a bus read, resetting them as a side effect of that read."},{"name":"Sticky error register","description":"Latches error or exception flags the first time each condition occurs and keeps them set until an explicit clear, storing one sticky bit per condition."},{"name":"Set/clear/toggle alias register","description":"Exposes one stored word through separate set, clear and toggle write addresses, so individual bits can be changed atomically without a read-modify-write."},{"name":"Snapshot capture register","description":"Copies the value of a live signal such as a running counter into a holding register when a trigger occurs, and keeps that captured value stable for later reading."},{"name":"Tri-state bus register","description":"Stores a word loaded from a shared bidirectional bus and drives it back onto the bus through tri-state buffers only while its output enable is active."},{"name":"Ring counter","description":"Circulates a single set bit through a closed loop of flip-flops, advancing one position per enabled clock, and stores the current token position as its state."},{"name":"Bit-addressable register","description":"Holds a word in which a single bit chosen by an index input can be set, cleared or written per cycle, while the remaining bits keep their values."},{"name":"Lockable configuration register","description":"Stores a configuration word together with a lock bit; once the lock is set, further writes to the word are ignored until reset."},{"name":"Write-once register","description":"Accepts the first write after reset into its data flip-flops, records that it has been written in a status flag, and ignores later writes."},{"name":"Masked-write register","description":"Updates its stored word using a write-data value and a per-bit mask supplied with each write, replacing only the masked bit positions."},{"name":"Exchange register pair","description":"Holds two words in separate registers that can each be loaded on their own or swapped with each other in a single clock cycle on a swap command."},{"name":"Endian-swap register","description":"Stores a multi-byte word and presents it on its output in either its natural or byte-reversed order, depending on an endianness control bit it also keeps."},{"name":"Bypass register","description":"Stores a word but can steer its input straight to its output through a bypass multiplexer when a bypass control is set, keeping the stored copy unchanged."},{"name":"Hardware/software shared register","description":"Keeps a word that can be written both by software over a bus and by internal hardware update logic, with a fixed priority choosing the winner when both write in the same cycle."},{"name":"State-retention register","description":"Pairs each main flip-flop with an always-powered shadow latch, saving the word before power-down and restoring it on power-up under save and restore controls."},{"name":"Self-clearing command register","description":"Lets software write command bits that stay high for exactly one clock to start an action and then clear themselves automatically, storing only the pending pulse bits."},{"name":"Latch-based register","description":"Stores a multi-bit word in level-sensitive latches that pass their input while the enable level is active and hold the last value when it goes inactive."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Parallel-in serial-out shift register","description":"Loads a whole word in parallel on a load strobe and then shifts it out one bit per clock on a serial output, holding the word in a single N-bit shift register."},{"name":"Serial-in serial-out delay line","description":"Passes a serial bit stream through a chain of N flip-flops so each bit reappears N clocks later, keeping only the chain of stage registers."},{"name":"Parallel-in parallel-out shift register","description":"Captures a word in parallel and shifts it one position per clock while all stages remain visible as a parallel output, storing the word in an N-bit register."},{"name":"Bidirectional shift register","description":"Shifts its contents left or right by one position per clock under a direction control, taking new bits from the left or right serial input, and keeps an N-bit data register."},{"name":"Ring counter","description":"Circulates a single preloaded token bit around a closed loop of flip-flops one position per clock to produce rotating select signals, storing the loop register."},{"name":"Circular rotate register","description":"Rotates an arbitrary data word by one bit position per clock with the bit leaving one end re-entering at the other, keeping an N-bit rotation register."},{"name":"Rotate-through-carry register","description":"Rotates a data word one position per clock through an extra carry flip-flop that sits between the two ends, storing the N-bit word plus the carry bit."},{"name":"Addressable tap shift register","description":"Shifts serial data through a chain of stages and outputs the stage selected by a tap address to give a run-time programmable delay, keeping the stage chain and the tap-select register."},{"name":"Fall-through shift FIFO","description":"Queues words in a column of stage registers where each entry moves toward the output whenever the stage ahead is empty, keeping per-stage data registers and per-stage occupied flags."},{"name":"Nonlinear feedback shift register","description":"Shifts a register by one position per clock and feeds back a nonlinear Boolean function of selected taps into the input to generate sequences, holding the N-bit state register."},{"name":"Double-data-rate shift register","description":"Shifts in serial data on both rising and falling clock edges into two interleaved stage chains that are merged into a parallel word, keeping a rising-edge chain and a falling-edge chain."},{"name":"Word-wide lane shift register","description":"Moves multi-bit words rather than single bits one stage per clock through a chain of word registers, keeping an array of word-wide stage registers."},{"name":"Latched-output shift register","description":"Shifts serial data into an internal shift stage and copies it to a separate output storage register on a latch strobe so outputs change only on update, keeping both the shift register and the storage latch register."},{"name":"Bit-slip alignment register","description":"Holds a window of incoming serial bits across two consecutive words and selects an output word at a slip offset that can be advanced one bit at a time to align word boundaries, keeping the window register and the slip-offset counter."},{"name":"Sticky-bit right-shift register","description":"Shifts a mantissa-style word right one position per clock while ORing every bit that falls off the low end into a sticky flip-flop, storing the data register and the sticky bit."},{"name":"Sequential arithmetic shift register","description":"Shifts a signed word right one position per clock while replicating the sign bit into the vacated top position, or left with zero fill, keeping an N-bit signed data register."},{"name":"Thermometer-code shift register","description":"Fills ones in from one end one position per clock on an increment and drains them from the same end on a decrement to represent a level as a thermometer code, keeping the N-bit thermometer register."},{"name":"Global history shift register","description":"Shifts each newly resolved outcome bit, such as a branch taken or not-taken result, into the low end of a register so the register holds the most recent N outcomes, storing the history bits."},{"name":"Data/valid delay pipeline","description":"Carries a data word together with its valid bit through a fixed number of stages one stage per clock to match the latency of a parallel path, keeping per-stage data and valid registers."},{"name":"Pre-trigger capture shift register","description":"Continuously shifts in samples of monitored signals and freezes on a trigger event so the history leading up to the trigger can be read out, keeping the sample chain and a frozen flag."},{"name":"Majority-vote sample filter","description":"Shifts the most recent N samples of a noisy input into a short register and drives a filtered output equal to the majority value of that window, keeping the sample window register and the registered output."},{"name":"Bit-stuffing shift register","description":"Shifts out a serial stream and inserts an extra zero after a run of consecutive ones, stalling the input while it does so, keeping the outgoing shift register and a run-length counter of recent ones."},{"name":"Manchester-encoding shift register","description":"Shifts out data bits one per bit period and expands each into a two-half-period transition pattern on the line, keeping the data shift register and a half-bit phase flip-flop."},{"name":"Two-dimensional shift matrix","description":"Arranges registers in a grid where the whole array shifts one row or one column per clock under a mode control, keeping an R-by-C array of stage registers."},{"name":"Sentinel-bit word assembler","description":"Preloads a single marker bit at one end of a register and shifts serial data in behind it so a complete word is recognized when the marker reaches the far end, keeping the shift register including the marker position and a word-ready flag."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Asynchronous ripple counter","description":"A chain of toggle flip-flops in which each stage is clocked by the previous stage's output, so the count advances in binary with ripple delay; its state is the bank of toggle flip-flops."},{"name":"Synchronous binary up counter","description":"Increments a binary count register by one on every enabled clock edge, using a common clock and parallel carry logic; it keeps a single N-bit count register."},{"name":"Synchronous binary down counter","description":"Decrements a binary count register by one on each enabled clock edge and signals a borrow when it passes zero; it keeps an N-bit count register."},{"name":"Up/down counter","description":"Increments or decrements its count register on each enabled clock depending on a direction input; it keeps the count register and optionally a registered direction bit."},{"name":"Dual-clock up/down counter","description":"Counts up on pulses from one clock input and down on pulses from a separate clock input, producing carry and borrow outputs; it keeps a count register and edge-capture flops for the two count inputs."},{"name":"BCD decade counter","description":"Steps a 4-bit register through decimal digits 0 to 9 and emits a carry when it rolls over to 0; it keeps one 4-bit BCD digit register."},{"name":"Cascaded multi-digit BCD counter","description":"Chains several decade stages so that each digit's rollover advances the next, giving a multi-digit decimal count; it keeps one 4-bit BCD register per digit."},{"name":"Excess-3 counter","description":"Steps through the ten excess-3 codes for decimal digits and produces a carry on wraparound; it keeps a 4-bit excess-3 code register."},{"name":"Modulo-N counter","description":"Counts from zero up to a programmed terminal value and then wraps back to zero, asserting a terminal-count output; it keeps a count register and a modulus register."},{"name":"Presettable loadable counter","description":"Counts normally but can be loaded in parallel with an arbitrary value from an input bus on a load strobe; it keeps a count register."},{"name":"Auto-reload down counter","description":"Counts down from a reload value and automatically reloads it upon reaching zero, pulsing an underflow output each cycle of the sequence; it keeps a count register and a reload register."},{"name":"Cascadable counter slice","description":"A fixed-width counter with count-enable-in and ripple-carry-out ports designed to be chained with identical slices into wider counters; it keeps its slice's count bits."},{"name":"Pipelined split counter","description":"Divides a wide counter into a low and a high segment with a registered carry between them so the high segment increments one cycle after the low segment wraps, enabling high clock rates; it keeps the low segment, the high segment and a carry pipeline flop."},{"name":"One-hot ring counter","description":"Circulates a single set bit around a closed shift register, advancing one position per clock to produce N decoded phases; it keeps an N-bit circular shift register."},{"name":"Thermometer-code counter","description":"Represents the count in unary by shifting ones into a register from one end on increment and removing them on decrement; it keeps an N-bit thermometer-coded register."},{"name":"Dual-modulus prescaler","description":"Divides an input pulse stream by either P or P+1 as selected by a mode control, used in front of slower counters; it keeps a small internal state counter and the registered mode select."},{"name":"Pulse-swallow counter","description":"Combines a dual-modulus prescaler with a program counter and a swallow counter to realize an overall division ratio of N times P plus S; it keeps the program count register and the swallow count register."},{"name":"Mixed-radix counter","description":"Advances a set of digits in which each digit has its own modulus (for example 60, 60, 24), carrying into the next digit on wraparound; it keeps one count register per digit."},{"name":"Nested loop index counter","description":"Generates multi-dimensional iteration indices by incrementing an inner index and advancing outer indices when inner ones reach their programmed bounds; it keeps one index register and one bound register per loop level."},{"name":"Programmable stride counter","description":"Adds a programmable step value to its count on each enabled clock instead of a fixed increment of one; it keeps a count register and a stride register."},{"name":"Event counter with capture","description":"Counts external events continuously and copies the running count into a capture register when a capture trigger arrives; it keeps a running count register and a captured-value register."},{"name":"Compare-match counter","description":"Runs a free counter and asserts a match output or interrupt whenever the count equals a programmed compare value; it keeps a count register, a compare register and a match flag."},{"name":"Wrapping counter with sticky overflow","description":"Increments freely and wraps on reaching its maximum, setting a sticky overflow flag that stays set until software clears it; it keeps a count register and an overflow flag bit."},{"name":"Retriggerable one-shot counter","description":"Produces an output pulse of a programmed number of clocks after a trigger, restarting the countdown if retriggered during the pulse; it keeps a down-count register and an output-active flag."},{"name":"Arbitrary-sequence counter","description":"Steps through a user-defined non-binary sequence of codes by looking up each next state in a small table indexed by the current state; it keeps a state register and a next-state lookup memory."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Half adder","description":"Adds two single bits to produce a sum bit and a carry-out bit, purely combinationally with no stored state."},{"name":"Full adder","description":"Adds two operand bits plus a carry-in to produce a sum bit and a carry-out bit, combinationally with no registers."},{"name":"Half subtractor","description":"Subtracts one bit from another, producing a difference bit and a borrow-out bit, with no internal state."},{"name":"Full subtractor","description":"Subtracts a subtrahend bit and a borrow-in from a minuend bit, producing a difference and borrow-out, with no stored state."},{"name":"Carry-skip adder","description":"Splits a ripple chain into blocks whose group-propagate signals let the carry bypass whole blocks, holding no registers."},{"name":"Conditional-sum adder","description":"Recursively computes sums for both possible carry-ins at every level and selects with multiplexers as carries resolve, keeping no state."},{"name":"Sklansky prefix adder","description":"Computes carries with a divide-and-conquer parallel-prefix tree of minimal depth and high fan-out, purely combinationally."},{"name":"Han-Carlson adder","description":"Uses a hybrid prefix network that computes odd-bit carries in a sparse Kogge-Stone tree and fills even bits in a final stage, with no registers."},{"name":"Ladner-Fischer adder","description":"Builds its carry network from a parallel-prefix structure trading depth against fan-out between Sklansky and Brent-Kung styles, with no stored state."},{"name":"Knowles adder","description":"Uses a parallel-prefix carry tree with configurable fan-out per level to balance wiring and logic depth, holding no state."},{"name":"Ling adder","description":"Computes a simplified pseudo-carry signal in its lookahead logic and recovers true sums at the end to shorten the critical path, without registers."},{"name":"Sparse-tree adder","description":"Generates only every k-th carry with a prefix tree and feeds them to small carry-select blocks that form the sums, keeping no state."},{"name":"Carry-increment adder","description":"Computes each block's sum assuming zero carry-in and then conditionally increments it when the incoming block carry arrives, with no registers."},{"name":"Manchester carry-chain adder","description":"Propagates carries along a chain of pass-transistor switches controlled by per-bit propagate, generate and kill signals, with dynamic precharge nodes but no clocked registers."},{"name":"Adder-subtractor","description":"Adds or subtracts two operands under a mode control by XOR-inverting the second operand and feeding the mode bit as carry-in, also flagging carry and overflow, with no stored state."},{"name":"Pipelined adder","description":"Breaks a wide carry chain into segments separated by pipeline registers that hold partial sums, operand slices and inter-segment carries."},{"name":"Digit-serial adder","description":"Adds two operands several bits per clock cycle, keeping a carry flip-flop between digits and shift registers for the operand and sum digits."},{"name":"4:2 compressor","description":"Reduces four operand bits plus a carry-in to a sum bit, a carry bit and a lateral carry-out for multi-operand addition, with no stored state."},{"name":"Multi-operand adder tree","description":"Sums many input words at once through a tree of two-input or compressor adders ending in a carry-propagate adder, optionally with pipeline registers between levels."},{"name":"Incrementer","description":"Adds one to an input word using a half-adder chain or prefix AND tree to form the carries, with no internal state."},{"name":"Decrementer","description":"Subtracts one from an input word by propagating a borrow through trailing zeros, with no internal registers."},{"name":"End-around-carry adder","description":"Adds two one's-complement operands and feeds the carry-out back into the least-significant carry-in, holding no state."},{"name":"Signed-digit redundant adder","description":"Adds two numbers in redundant signed-digit representation with carry propagation limited to adjacent digits, producing a redundant result without registers."},{"name":"Excess-3 adder","description":"Adds two excess-3 coded decimal digits using a binary adder and a correction stage that adds or subtracts three, with no stored state."},{"name":"Sum-of-absolute-differences unit","description":"Computes absolute differences of paired operand elements with subtractors and conditional negation and sums them, holding an accumulator register for the running total."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Dadda tree multiplier","description":"Reduces the partial-product matrix with the minimum number of full and half adders at each column height stage, then uses a final carry-propagate adder; it keeps registered input operands and a registered product output."},{"name":"Baugh-Wooley multiplier","description":"Multiplies two's-complement operands in an array by inverting selected partial-product bits and adding correction constants so no sign extension is needed; it keeps operand input registers and a product output register."},{"name":"Radix-2 Booth sequential multiplier","description":"Examines one multiplier bit pair per cycle and adds, subtracts or skips the multiplicand into a running partial product; it keeps a multiplicand register, a combined accumulator/multiplier shift register, an extra Booth bit and an iteration counter."},{"name":"Radix-8 Booth multiplier","description":"Recodes the multiplier into overlapping 4-bit groups that select multiples from minus four to plus four times the multiplicand, so it generates one-third as many partial products; it keeps a precomputed triple-multiplicand register and pipeline registers between the recoding, reduction and final-add stages."},{"name":"Serial-parallel multiplier","description":"Takes one multiplier bit per clock against a parallel multiplicand and shifts the product out serially through a chain of carry-save adder cells; it keeps the parallel multiplicand register, per-cell sum and carry flops, and a bit counter."},{"name":"Digit-serial multiplier","description":"Processes the multiplier several bits per cycle, adding a digit-by-multiplicand product into a shifted accumulator; it keeps a multiplicand register, a multiplier digit shift register, an accumulator and a digit counter."},{"name":"Karatsuba multiplier","description":"Splits each operand into high and low halves and forms the product from three half-width multiplications plus additions and subtractions; it keeps registers for the three sub-products and the recombined output."},{"name":"Toom-Cook multiplier","description":"Splits operands into k limbs, evaluates them as polynomials at several points, multiplies the evaluations pointwise and interpolates the result; it keeps evaluation-point registers, pointwise-product registers and an interpolation accumulator."},{"name":"Constant-coefficient CSD multiplier","description":"Multiplies an input by a fixed constant using hardwired shifts and add/subtract operations derived from the constant's canonical-signed-digit form; it keeps an input register and an output product register."},{"name":"Multiple-constant multiplier block","description":"Computes the products of one input with a set of fixed coefficients through a shared shift-add graph that reuses intermediate terms; it keeps the input register and one output register per coefficient."},{"name":"Squarer unit","description":"Computes the square of a single operand using a folded partial-product array that merges symmetric terms to roughly halve the adder count; it keeps an operand register and a result register."},{"name":"Pipelined array multiplier","description":"Lays out the adder rows of an array multiplier as pipeline stages so a new operand pair can enter every cycle; it keeps inter-stage registers holding partial sums, carries and delayed operand bits, plus a valid bit per stage."},{"name":"Carry-save iterative multiplier","description":"Adds one partial product per cycle into a redundant sum/carry accumulator and runs a carry-propagate addition only at the end; it keeps sum and carry accumulator registers, a multiplier shift register and a step counter."},{"name":"Mitchell logarithmic multiplier","description":"Approximates a product by finding each operand's leading-one position, adding the approximated logarithms and taking an approximate antilogarithm; it keeps registers for the leading-one positions, the fractional mantissas and the approximate product."},{"name":"Truncated fixed-width multiplier","description":"Produces only the upper half of the product by omitting low-order partial-product columns and adding a compensation bias; it keeps operand registers and an n-bit result register."},{"name":"Complex multiplier","description":"Multiplies two complex numbers using three real multiplications and five additions in the Gauss arrangement; it keeps registers for the real and imaginary inputs, the intermediate products and the complex result."},{"name":"Distributed-arithmetic multiplier","description":"Computes a sum of products with fixed coefficients by using the input bits, one bit position per cycle, to address a precomputed table and shift-accumulating the outputs; it keeps the coefficient-sum ROM, input shift registers, an accumulator and a bit counter."},{"name":"Quarter-square LUT multiplier","description":"Forms a product as the difference of looked-up quarter-squares of the operand sum and difference; it keeps the quarter-square lookup ROM, sum and difference registers and a product register."},{"name":"SIMD partitioned multiplier","description":"Can be configured to perform one full-width multiply or several independent narrower lane multiplies by breaking carry and partial-product paths at lane boundaries; it keeps a mode register, operand registers and a lane-packed result register."},{"name":"Vedic Urdhva multiplier","description":"Generates all vertical and crosswise partial products of the operand digits in parallel and sums them column by column with carries, following the Urdhva-Tiryagbhyam scheme; it keeps operand registers and a result register."},{"name":"Stochastic bitstream multiplier","description":"Multiplies two probabilities encoded as random bitstreams by ANDing them bit by bit and counting the ones in the output stream; it keeps two stream-generator state registers, an output ones counter and a stream-length counter."},{"name":"RNS channel multiplier","description":"Multiplies operands held as residues modulo a set of co-prime moduli, with one independent modular multiplier per channel; it keeps per-channel residue input registers and per-channel residue product registers."},{"name":"Systolic linear-array multiplier","description":"Pipes multiplier bits through a one-dimensional chain of identical cells, each holding one multiplicand bit and adding into a passing partial sum; it keeps per-cell multiplicand bit, partial-sum, carry and control-token flops."},{"name":"Tiled multi-precision multiplier","description":"Builds a wide product by scheduling narrower hardware multiplies over operand limb pairs and accumulating them at the correct shifted offsets; it keeps limb index counters, operand limb buffers and a wide multi-word accumulator."},{"name":"Interleaved modular multiplier","description":"Computes A times B mod N by scanning B bit by bit, doubling and conditionally adding A to a partial result, then subtracting N when the partial result reaches or exceeds N; it keeps the A, B and modulus registers, a partial-result register and a bit counter."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Goldschmidt divider","description":"Iteratively multiplies the dividend and divisor by the same correction factor until the divisor approaches one, keeping numerator, denominator, correction-factor and iteration-count registers."},{"name":"Constant reciprocal-multiply divider","description":"Divides by a fixed or preloaded divisor by multiplying with a stored magic reciprocal and shifting, holding the magic constant, shift amount and pipelined product registers."},{"name":"Bit-serial divider","description":"Computes a quotient from serially arriving operand bits using a one-bit subtractor per cycle, keeping a partial-remainder shift register, divisor register, borrow flip-flop and bit counter."},{"name":"Combinational array divider","description":"Computes quotient and remainder in a single combinational pass through rows of controlled subtract cells, with only optional input and output operand registers."},{"name":"Non-performing divider","description":"Performs a trial subtraction each cycle but writes the difference back only when it is non-negative, keeping partial-remainder, divisor, quotient and step-counter registers."},{"name":"Pipelined unrolled divider","description":"Spreads the digit-recurrence steps across pipeline stages so a new division can start every cycle, keeping per-stage partial-remainder, divisor, quotient-bits and valid registers."},{"name":"Online MSB-first divider","description":"Produces signed-digit quotient digits most-significant first after a small online delay as operand digits stream in, keeping redundant residual, accumulated operand and digit-position registers."},{"name":"Modulo-by-constant reducer","description":"Computes the remainder of a wide input modulo a fixed constant by folding chunks with precomputed weights, keeping a folded-residue accumulator and chunk index register."},{"name":"Divide-by-three FSM","description":"Computes the quotient and remainder of a serial binary stream divided by three using a small remainder-state register that also emits quotient bits into an output shift register."},{"name":"Barrett reduction unit","description":"Reduces a product modulo a fixed modulus by estimating the quotient with a precomputed scaled reciprocal and applying final correction subtractions, keeping modulus, reciprocal, quotient-estimate and residue registers."},{"name":"GF(2) polynomial divider","description":"Performs polynomial long division over GF(2) by XOR-shifting the divisor polynomial into the dividend, keeping a remainder register, divisor polynomial register, quotient shift register and degree counter."},{"name":"Binary-field divider","description":"Computes a/b in GF(2^m) using a binary extended-Euclid style iteration, keeping four polynomial registers for the working pairs, degree-difference register and iteration control state."},{"name":"BCD decimal divider","description":"Divides packed-BCD operands digit by digit using repeated decimal subtraction with multiples of the divisor, keeping a decimal partial-remainder, divisor-multiple table, quotient-digit and digit-position registers."},{"name":"Early-termination normalizing divider","description":"Normalizes operands with leading-zero counts to skip unnecessary iterations and finishes in a variable number of cycles, keeping shift-amount, partial-remainder, quotient, remaining-iterations and done registers."},{"name":"Carry-save remainder divider","description":"Holds the partial remainder in redundant carry-save form so each iteration avoids a full carry propagation, keeping sum and carry remainder registers, a divisor register and on-the-fly quotient conversion registers."},{"name":"Signed division wrapper","description":"Wraps an unsigned divide core with operand absolute-value conversion, sign recording, and quotient/remainder sign fix-up, keeping saved sign flags, divide-by-zero and overflow status registers."},{"name":"Repeated-subtraction divider","description":"Subtracts the divisor from the dividend once per cycle while incrementing a quotient counter, keeping a running-remainder register, divisor register and quotient counter."},{"name":"Combined divide/square-root unit","description":"Shares one digit-recurrence datapath for both division and square root, selecting the operation per request and keeping operation-mode, partial-remainder, root/quotient, divisor and iteration registers."},{"name":"Prescaled digit-recurrence divider","description":"Scales the divisor and dividend by a table-derived factor so quotient digits can be selected by simple rounding of the residual, keeping scale-factor, scaled-operand, residual and quotient registers."},{"name":"Exact divider","description":"Computes the quotient when the divisor is known to divide the dividend evenly using LSB-first modular-inverse multiplication, keeping the divisor inverse, working dividend and quotient shift registers."},{"name":"Modular inverse unit","description":"Computes the inverse of a value modulo an odd modulus using a binary extended-Euclidean iteration, keeping u, v, x1, x2 working registers, the modulus and a busy flag."},{"name":"Mitchell logarithmic approximate divider","description":"Approximates a quotient by converting operands to piecewise-linear logarithms, subtracting them and taking the antilogarithm, keeping leading-one position, mantissa-fraction and result registers."},{"name":"Multi-word long divider","description":"Divides multi-precision integers word by word with normalized quotient-digit estimation and add-back correction, keeping a scratch memory for the remainder words, divisor words, quotient words and word-index counters."},{"name":"SIMD partitioned divider","description":"Performs several independent narrow divisions in parallel lanes of one wide iterative datapath, keeping per-lane partial-remainder, divisor and quotient fields plus a lane-width mode register."},{"name":"Table-lookup reciprocal approximation unit","description":"Produces a low-precision reciprocal seed from a ROM indexed by leading divisor bits plus a linear interpolation term, keeping the ROM table, index register and interpolated output register."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Window comparator","description":"Reports whether an input value lies between a lower and an upper bound, holding both bounds in programmable registers and latching the in-range result in an output flag register."},{"name":"Hysteresis threshold comparator","description":"Compares an input against separate rising and falling thresholds so the output changes only on a decisive crossing, keeping both threshold registers and a registered output-state bit."},{"name":"MSB-first serial comparator","description":"Compares two operands one bit per clock starting from the most significant bit, keeping a small decided/less-than/greater-than state register that freezes once the first differing bit is seen."},{"name":"LSB-first serial comparator","description":"Compares two operands one bit per clock starting from the least significant bit, overwriting a running relation register whenever the current bit pair differs so the final value reflects the most significant difference."},{"name":"Mode-selectable signed/unsigned comparator","description":"Produces less-than, equal and greater-than flags for two operands under either two's-complement or unsigned interpretation, with a mode register selecting the interpretation and a registered flag output."},{"name":"Masked equality comparator","description":"Tests two words for equality only on bit positions enabled by a programmable mask, storing the mask and reference pattern in registers and latching a match flag."},{"name":"Min/max selector","description":"Routes the smaller and the larger of two inputs to separate outputs using a single magnitude decision, holding the selected results in output registers."},{"name":"Compare-exchange cell","description":"Takes two keys with attached payloads and swaps them if they are out of order, registering the ordered key/payload pairs and a swapped flag for use as a node inside larger ordering structures."},{"name":"Threshold crossing detector","description":"Flags when a sampled signal crosses a programmed level and indicates the direction of the crossing, keeping the threshold register, the previous-sample register, and a crossing-event flag."},{"name":"Hamming-distance threshold comparator","description":"Counts the bit positions in which two words differ and compares that count to a programmable tolerance, holding the tolerance register and a registered near-match flag."},{"name":"Memory-protection region checker","description":"Compares an access address against several base/limit region pairs to decide whether it falls inside a permitted region, storing per-region base, limit and permission registers plus a registered fault flag."},{"name":"Timer compare-match unit","description":"Compares a free-running count against a programmed compare value and raises a match event when they are equal, keeping the compare register and a sticky match-pending flag."},{"name":"Prefix-length matcher","description":"Checks whether the leading N bits of an input address equal those of a stored prefix, where N comes from a prefix-length register, and stores the prefix and its length alongside a registered hit flag."},{"name":"Lexicographic multi-word comparator","description":"Orders two long keys by comparing them one word per cycle from the most significant word downward, keeping a word index counter and a running relation register until a difference or the end is reached."},{"name":"Wraparound sequence-number comparator","description":"Decides whether one modular sequence number is ahead of another using half-range serial-number arithmetic, holding a reference sequence register and a registered newer/older/equal result."},{"name":"Tolerance comparator","description":"Reports approximate equality when the absolute difference of two values does not exceed a programmable epsilon, storing the epsilon register and a registered within-tolerance flag."},{"name":"Fraction cross-multiply comparator","description":"Orders two ratios a/b and c/d by comparing the products a*d and c*b without performing division, holding the two product registers and a registered relation result."},{"name":"Gray-code magnitude comparator","description":"Determines the ordering of two Gray-coded values directly by scanning bits with a running parity that tracks inversion, keeping a registered relation output and no binary conversion stage."},{"name":"BCD magnitude comparator","description":"Compares two packed binary-coded-decimal numbers digit by digit from the most significant digit, registering the less-than/equal/greater-than result."},{"name":"Carry-save sum-equality checker","description":"Tests whether the sum of two operands equals a target value without a carry-propagating addition, using per-bit carry prediction logic, with the target held in a register and a latched equality flag."},{"name":"Cascadable comparator slice","description":"Compares a fixed-width nibble or byte of two operands and combines its result with less/equal/greater cascade inputs from a lower-order slice, optionally registering its cascade outputs for chaining wider compares."},{"name":"Pipelined wide comparator","description":"Splits a very wide comparison into chunks evaluated in parallel and merged over several pipeline stages, keeping per-stage registers of partial equal/greater results and a valid bit per stage."},{"name":"Sign-magnitude comparator","description":"Orders two sign-magnitude encoded numbers by handling the sign bits and then comparing magnitudes with order reversed for negatives, treating the two zero encodings as equal and registering the result."},{"name":"Vector predicate comparator","description":"Compares corresponding lanes of two packed vectors in parallel under a selected relation code and writes one result bit per lane into a predicate mask register, keeping the relation-select register as well."},{"name":"FIFO watermark comparator","description":"Compares a queue's fill level against programmable almost-full and almost-empty thresholds, storing both threshold registers and registered watermark status flags."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Bit-slice ALU","description":"A cascadable 4-bit ALU slice that performs a function-selected arithmetic or logic operation on its operand nibbles and emits carry-generate, carry-propagate and zero outputs for chaining; it keeps an optional registered result nibble and carry-out flop."},{"name":"SIMD packed ALU","description":"Performs one selected add, subtract or logic operation in parallel on byte, halfword or word lanes of a wide operand, breaking carries at lane boundaries per a lane-size control; it keeps a result register and a per-lane flag vector register."},{"name":"Accumulator-based ALU","description":"Combines an incoming operand with an internal accumulator using a selected operation such as add, subtract, AND, OR or XOR and writes the result back; it keeps the accumulator register and a status register of carry, zero, negative and overflow flags."},{"name":"Boolean function unit","description":"Computes any of the sixteen two-input bitwise logic functions on two operands, choosing the function with a 4-bit truth-table code; it keeps a registered result and a zero flag."},{"name":"Three-input ternary-logic unit","description":"Applies an arbitrary 8-bit truth table bitwise across three operands to produce one result word in a single operation; it keeps the truth-table immediate register and the output register."},{"name":"Rotate-through-carry unit","description":"Rotates an operand left or right by one or more positions with the carry flag inserted as an extra bit in the rotation path; it keeps the carry flag register and the rotated result register."},{"name":"Bit-field extract/insert unit","description":"Extracts a field of given start position and width from a source word with zero or sign extension, or inserts a field into a destination word; it keeps position and width control registers and a result register."},{"name":"Rotate-and-mask unit","description":"Rotates an operand by a shift amount and then ANDs it with a mask generated from begin and end bit indices, optionally merging it into a destination; it keeps the mask-bounds registers and the result register."},{"name":"Min/max unit","description":"Selects the smaller or larger of two operands under signed or unsigned comparison according to an opcode; it keeps the selected result register and a flag recording which operand won."},{"name":"Clamp unit","description":"Bounds an input value between programmable lower and upper limits, outputting the limit when exceeded; it keeps the lower-limit, upper-limit and result registers plus a clipped status flag."},{"name":"Conditional-select unit","description":"Chooses between two operands based on a condition code evaluated against the current flags, implementing conditional move and select instructions; it keeps the selected result register."},{"name":"Condition-code evaluator","description":"Decodes a condition field such as equal, less-than or carry-set against stored N, Z, C and V flags to produce a single taken or true signal; it keeps the flags register that ALU operations update."},{"name":"Address generation unit","description":"Computes effective addresses as base plus scaled index plus displacement with optional base writeback for auto-increment modes; it keeps the computed address register and an alignment-fault flag."},{"name":"Multi-precision add-with-carry unit","description":"Adds or subtracts word-sized limbs of large integers over successive operations using the carry or borrow from the previous limb; it keeps the carry flag register between operations and a per-limb result register."},{"name":"Byte-permute unit","description":"Rearranges the bytes of one or two source words according to a selector vector to implement byte swap, broadcast and shuffle operations; it keeps the selector register and the permuted result register."},{"name":"Sum-of-absolute-differences unit","description":"Computes absolute differences between corresponding lanes of two packed operands and adds them together into a running sum; it keeps the accumulated sum register."},{"name":"Increment/decrement unit","description":"Adds or subtracts one or a small constant step from an operand with fast carry handling and produces zero and wrap flags; it keeps the result register and the flag bits."},{"name":"Single-bit manipulation unit","description":"Sets, clears, inverts or tests one bit of an operand selected by an index operand, producing the modified word and the tested bit as a flag; it keeps the result register and the test flag."},{"name":"Halving average unit","description":"Adds two operands with one extra bit of precision and shifts right by one, with selectable round-up or truncation, per lane; it keeps the averaged result register."},{"name":"Flagged adder-subtractor","description":"Adds or subtracts two operands under a mode bit by conditionally inverting the second operand and injecting carry-in, generating carry, overflow, zero and sign flags; it keeps the sum register and the four-flag status register."},{"name":"Residue number system ALU","description":"Performs addition, subtraction and multiplication independently in several small moduli channels with no carry between them; it keeps one residue register per modulus channel."},{"name":"Stochastic computing ALU","description":"Operates on random bitstreams whose density encodes values, using AND gates for multiplication and multiplexers for scaled addition, then counts output ones to recover a result; it keeps the output ones counter and a stream-length counter."},{"name":"Bit-serial ALU","description":"Executes add, subtract and logic operations one bit per clock on operands shifted in least-significant bit first, using a selected one-bit function; it keeps the operand and result shift registers and a carry flop."},{"name":"SIMD compare-mask unit","description":"Compares corresponding lanes of two packed operands for equal, greater-than or less-than and outputs an all-ones or all-zeros mask per lane plus a packed bitmask summary; it keeps the mask result register."},{"name":"Vector reduction ALU","description":"Combines all elements of a vector into one scalar by repeated application of a selected operation such as sum, min, max, AND or OR over multiple cycles; it keeps the partial-result register and an element index counter."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Logarithmic rotator","description":"Rotates a word by any amount using log2(N) cascaded 2:1 mux stages, each stage rotating by a power of two, and holds the rotated word in an output register."},{"name":"Bidirectional single-network rotator","description":"Performs left or right rotation on one left-only rotate network by converting right amounts to their width complement, and keeps registered copies of the direction bit, amount and result."},{"name":"Pipelined barrel shifter","description":"Splits the shift stages across several clock stages for high frequency, and keeps the pipeline registers holding partially shifted data, remaining amount bits and a valid bit per stage."},{"name":"Crossbar shifter","description":"Decodes the shift amount to one-hot and drives an N-by-N switch matrix so every output bit selects its source in one level, with a registered one-hot select vector and output word."},{"name":"Coarse-fine two-level shifter","description":"Shifts first by whole bytes or words in a coarse stage and then by the residual bit count in a fine stage, and holds the intermediate coarse-shifted word in a register."},{"name":"Rotate-and-mask unit","description":"Rotates a source word and ANDs it with a mask generated from begin and end bit positions, merging under the mask with a destination, and keeps the operand, mask and result registers."},{"name":"Bitfield extract unit","description":"Right-shifts a source to bring a field of given offset and length to bit zero, then zero- or sign-fills the upper bits, and holds the offset, length and extracted-field registers."},{"name":"Bitfield insert unit","description":"Left-shifts a field to a given offset and merges it into a destination word under a generated mask, keeping the destination, field, offset and length registers."},{"name":"Rotate-through-carry unit","description":"Rotates a word together with a carry flag as an extra (N+1)th bit by an arbitrary count, and keeps the data register and the carry-flag register."},{"name":"Shifter operand unit with carry-out","description":"Applies LSL, LSR, ASR or ROR by an immediate or register amount to an ALU operand and produces the last bit shifted out, keeping a registered shifted operand and shifter carry-out flag."},{"name":"Floating-point alignment shifter","description":"Right-shifts the smaller significand by the exponent difference and ORs all shifted-out bits into guard, round and sticky bits, holding the aligned significand and the GRS register."},{"name":"Rounding right shifter","description":"Shifts a fixed-point value right by a variable amount and adds a rounding increment derived from the dropped bits, keeping the shifted value and a registered rounding-mode setting."},{"name":"Saturating left shifter","description":"Shifts a signed value left by a variable amount and clamps to the most positive or negative value when significant bits would be lost, keeping the result register and a sticky saturation flag."},{"name":"Overrange-clamping shifter","description":"Treats shift amounts at or beyond the word width specially by forcing zero or sign-fill output instead of wrapping the count, and keeps the result plus an out-of-range indicator register."},{"name":"SIMD lane-partitioned shifter","description":"Shifts or rotates a wide word as independent 8-, 16- or 32-bit lanes by breaking cross-lane paths according to a lane-size setting, and holds the lane-mode register and per-lane results."},{"name":"Byte-lane load aligner","description":"Rotates a fetched memory word by the low address bits so the addressed byte, halfword or word lands at bit zero, then zero- or sign-extends it, holding the address offset and size registers and the aligned result."},{"name":"Store data steering rotator","description":"Rotates store data up to the byte position given by the address offset and generates matching byte-enable strobes, keeping registered aligned data and the byte-enable vector."},{"name":"Stream byte realigner","description":"Shifts incoming bus beats by a byte offset so a misaligned stream comes out aligned, carrying the leftover bytes of each beat in a residue register along with the current offset register."},{"name":"Wide segmented shifter","description":"Shifts a multi-word value by splitting it into segments that each shift locally and pass spill-over bits to their neighbor, keeping per-segment registers and the inter-segment spill registers."},{"name":"QC-LDPC circulant shifter","description":"Cyclically rotates a block of Z soft values by a per-entry shift taken from a parity-check base matrix for a configurable lifting size, keeping the lifting-size register, the shift-value ROM and the rotated block register."},{"name":"Fixed multi-rotation XOR network","description":"Computes the XOR of several constant-amount rotations and shifts of a word, as in hash sigma functions, in one cycle, and keeps only the input and output word registers."},{"name":"Vector element slide unit","description":"Moves whole elements of a vector register up or down by a scalar offset, filling vacated positions from a scalar or leaving them unchanged, and holds the offset register and destination element buffer."},{"name":"Vector lane rotator","description":"Rotates the elements of a vector across lanes by a variable element count in a single pass, keeping the element count, element-width setting and rotated vector registers."},{"name":"Inverse-butterfly and output register."},{"name":"Reverse-shift-reverse shifter","description":"Performs right shifts on left-only shift hardware by bit-reversing the input, shifting left and reversing the result, {"kinds":[{"name":"Fully-associative cache","description":"Stores lines in any entry by comparing the request address against every stored tag in parallel, keeping per-entry tag, valid, dirty and data registers plus replacement state."},{"name":"Sector cache","description":"Shares one address tag across several sub-blocks of a line, keeping one tag per sector and separate valid and dirty bits per sub-block so that sub-blocks can be filled independently."},{"name":"Skewed-associative cache","description":"Indexes each way with a different hash of the address to spread conflicting lines, keeping per-way tag, valid and data arrays along with the hash function configuration."},{"name":"Column-associative cache","description":"Probes a primary set and then a rehashed alternate set in a direct-mapped array, keeping tag and data arrays plus a per-line rehash bit that records which index function placed the line."},{"name":"Write-back eviction buffer","description":"Holds dirty lines evicted from the cache until they drain to the next memory level, keeping entries of victim address, data and valid flags that later requests can match against."},{"name":"Write-combining buffer","description":"Merges multiple partial stores to the same line into one burst write, keeping a line address, data bytes and a per-byte write mask for each entry."},{"name":"MESI line state controller","description":"Updates a cache line's coherence state on local reads, writes and incoming snoops, keeping a two-bit Modified/Exclusive/Shared/Invalid state per line and issuing bus or interconnect requests."},{"name":"Snooping bus cache controller","description":"Watches the shared bus for other masters' transactions, looks up their addresses in a duplicate tag copy and supplies data, invalidates or downgrades lines, keeping the duplicate tags and a pending-snoop register."},{"name":"Way predictor","description":"Guesses which way of a set-associative cache will hit so that only one data way needs to be read, keeping a table of predicted way numbers indexed by address or PC bits."},{"name":"Next-line prefetcher","description":"Issues a fetch for the line following each demand miss, keeping the last miss address and a small queue of outstanding prefetch addresses."},{"name":"Stream buffer","description":"Prefetches sequential lines after a miss into a small FIFO beside the cache and supplies them on later misses, keeping the stream head address, entry tags, valid bits and line data."},{"name":"Loop buffer","description":"Captures the instructions of a short backward-branching loop so that fetch can replay them without accessing the instruction cache, keeping instruction entries, the loop start and end addresses, and a capture or replay mode flag."},{"name":"Trace cache","description":"Stores dynamic instruction sequences that span taken branches as single lines, keeping per-line start address, branch outcome flags, instruction slots and the next fetch address."},{"name":"Micro-op cache","description":"Caches decoded micro-operations keyed by instruction fetch address so the decoders can be bypassed, keeping tag, valid, micro-op slot and replacement registers for each way."},{"name":"Random replacement unit","description":"Selects a victim way pseudo-randomly on each fill, keeping a free-running pseudo-random state register and a that advances on every fill."},{"name":"RRIP replacement unit","description":"Predicts how soon each line will be reused and evicts a line predicted to be reused far in the future, keeping a small re-reference prediction counter per line that ages when no candidate is found."},{"name":"LFU replacement unit","description":"Evicts the least frequently accessed line in a set, keeping a per-line access-frequency counter that increments on hits and is periodically halved."},{"name":"Set-dueling policy monitor","description":"Dedicates a few sample sets to each of two replacement or insertion policies and steers the remaining sets toward the policy that misses less, keeping a policy-selection counter and the sample-set designations."},{"name":"Dead-block predictor","description":"Predicts when a cached line will not be referenced again so it can be evicted early or bypassed, keeping a table of signature-indexed confidence counters and a per-line signature field."},{"name":"Cache maintenance engine","description":"Walks the cache by set and way to clean, invalidate or flush lines on software command, keeping current set and way index registers, the operation type and a busy status bit."},{"name":"Cache lockdown controller","description":"Pins selected lines or ways so they are excluded from replacement, keeping a way-lock mask register and per-line lock bits set by back-invalidate addresses and per-line presence bits for the upper caches."},{"name":"Cache ECC scrubber","description":"Periodically reads cache lines in the background, corrects single-bit errors {"kinds":[{"name":"Odd-ratio 50% duty divider","description":"Divides a clock by an odd integer with a symmetric output by combining a rising-edge modulo counter with a falling-edge retimed copy, keeping the count register and the rising- and falling-edge phase flops."},{"name":"Half-integer clock divider","description":"Produces a clock at the input frequency divided by N.5 by alternating P+1 under a modulus-control input, keeping a small state register of flops that form the switchable divide chain."},{"name":"Pulse-swallow counter","description":"Drives a dual-modulus prescaler so that the overall division ratio is N*P+S, keeping a program counter register and a swallow counter register that are reloaded each output cycle."},{"name":"Fractional-N modulus setting registers and the modulator accumulator registers."},{"name":"Rational M/N clock-enable generator","description":"Emits an enable pulse on exactly M of every N input cycles using a Bresenham-style error accumulator, keeping the M and N configuration registers and the running error register."},{"name":"Ripple toggle-flop divider chain","description":"Divides a clock by successive powers of two through a cascade of toggle flip-flops, each clocked by the previous stage, with each stage's toggle flop as its state."},{"name":"Programmable divider with shadowed counter."},{"name":"Quadrature clock generator","description":"Derives four clocks spaced 90 degrees apart by dividing a 2x or 4x input clock through a twisted-ring of flops, keeping those phase flops as its state."},{"name":"Multi-output phase-offset clock generator","description":"Produces several divided clocks from one source, each with its own programmable phase offset relative to a shared cycle counter, keeping the shared counter and per-output divide and offset registers."},{"name":"Phase-frequency detector","description":"Compares reference and feedback clock edges and asserts UP or DOWN pulses proportional to their phase difference, keeping the UP and DN flops that are cleared together by a reset path."},{"name":"Bang-bang phase detector","description":"Samples the reference clock with the feedback clock (or vice versa) to produce a single early/late decision per cycle, keeping the sampling flop and a registered early/late output."},{"name":"PLL lock and a lock flag."},{"name":"Digitally controlled oscillator control word","description":"Converts a tuning code into enables for capacitor or inverter banks in a digitally controlled ring or LC target register and the oscillator code."},{"name":"PLL startup sequencer","description":"Steps a PLL through power-up, band calibration, loop closure and lock wait before releasing the output clock, counter running on an independent clock and flags a failure when no monitored edge arrives within a timeout, keeping the timeout counter, a synchronized edge-toggle sample and a failure flag."},{"name":"Clock failover switch controller","description":"Automatically moves the system clock from a primary to a backup source when the primary is reported failed, keeping a selected-source {"kinds":[{"name":"Single-bit level synchronizer","description":"Passes a slowly changing level signal into a destination clock domain through a chain of back-to-back flip-flops, keeping only the stage registers of that chain."},{"name":"Toggle pulse synchronizer","description":"Converts a source-domain pulse into a toggle of a source register, synchronizes that toggle through destination flops, and XORs the last two stages to regenerate a destination pulse."},{"name":"Two-phase (NRZ) handshake synchronizer","description":"Signals transfers by toggling a request register in the sender and an acknowledge register in the receiver, each synchronized into the opposite domain through flop chains."},{"name":"Mux-recirculation data synchronizer","description":"Holds a multi-bit bus in a source register and synchronizes only a load-enable bit, which selects a destination capture register to load the bus or recirculate its current value."},{"name":"MCP bus synchronizer with acknowledge feedback","description":"Launches a held data word with a toggled enable, synchronizes the enable to capture the word in the destination, and returns a synchronized acknowledge toggle that frees the source holding register."},{"name":"Feedback pulse synchronizer with busy","description":"Forwards an event pulse across domains via a toggle, returns a synchronized acknowledge, and keeps a source-side busy register that blocks new pulses until the round trip completes."},{"name":"Asynchronous FIFO flag generator","description":"Compares a local pointer with a synchronized copy of the remote Gray pointer to produce registered full, empty, almost-full and almost-empty flags, keeping the synchronizer stages and flag registers."},{"name":"Gray-coded event counter synchronizer","description":"Counts source-domain events in a Gray-coded counter register, synchronizes it into the destination, and converts it back to binary in a destination register to obtain the event total."},{"name":"Clock-gate enable synchronizer","description":"Synchronizes a gating request into the target clock domain and latches it on the inactive clock phase so the integrated clock gate receives a stable enable, keeping the sync flops and the enable latch."},{"name":"Metastability-detecting synchronizer","description":"Samples an asynchronous input in parallel flops and flags disagreement between the main and a shadow sampling register, keeping both sample registers and an error-flag register."},{"name":"Mesochronous phase-select synchronizer","description":"Captures data from a same-frequency, unknown-phase clock into two alternately clocked registers and uses a calibrated phase-select register to pick the safe one for the receiver."},{"name":"Clock-compensation elastic buffer","description":"Bridges plesiochronous clocks with a small circular buffer that inserts or deletes designated skip symbols to absorb frequency drift, keeping buffer entries, write/read indices and a fill-level monitor."},{"name":"Ratiochronous transfer-window scheduler","description":"For clocks with a known rational frequency ratio, uses a phase counter register to predict safe sampling edges and enables direct transfers only within those windows."},{"name":"Sticky status bit synchronizer with clear handshake","description":"Latches asynchronous status events into a sticky register in the source domain, synchronizes it to software's domain, and clears it via a synchronized clear-request toggle."},{"name":"Quasi-static configuration synchronizer","description":"Holds configuration values in a shadow register written in one domain and copies them to an active register in another domain when a synchronized update strobe arrives."},{"name":"Snapshot capture synchronizer","description":"On a destination request toggle, freezes a source-domain running value into a snapshot register and returns a completion toggle so the destination can safely read the frozen value."},{"name":"Pulse-pending counter synchronizer","description":"Accumulates bursts of fast-domain pulses in a pending counter and drains them one at a time through a handshake into a slower domain, keeping the counter and handshake toggle registers."},{"name":"Asynchronous-set wakeup synchronizer","description":"Uses a flop asynchronously set by an external wake event with no clock running, then synchronizes it into the newly started clock domain and clears it on a synchronized acknowledge."},{"name":"Cross-domain register access bridge","description":"Carries bus read/write transactions between domains by holding address, write data and read data in registers and exchanging request and response toggles through synchronizers."},{"name":"Clock-presence detector","description":"Toggles a register in a monitored clock domain and synchronizes it into a reference domain, where a timeout counter flags when no toggles have been observed."},{"name":"Token-ring pointer FIFO synchronizer","description":"Implements a dual-clock FIFO whose read and write positions are one-hot token rings, with the tokens synchronized across domains to detect full and empty conditions."},{"name":"Source-synchronous input capture","description":"Samples incoming data with a forwarded clock into capture registers and writes them into a ring-oscillator clock while an asynchronous handshake is resolved by a mutual-exclusion element, keeping the clock-enable state and the handshake latch."},{"name":"Mutual-exclusion request arbiter","description":"Resolves two asynchronous requests with a cross-coupled latch followed by a metastability filter, holding which requester currently owns the shared resource."}]}

{"kinds":[{"name":"Windowed watchdog","description":"Counts down from a reload value and flags a fault if it is serviced either too late or too early, keeping a down-counter, a window-open threshold register, a reload register and an early/late fault status register."},{"name":"Center-aligned PWM generator","description":"Drives a counter that ramps up then down each period and toggles the output state flops."},{"name":"Input capture unit","description":"Latches the free-running timer value when a selected edge appears on an input pin, keeping an edge-select register, a capture register, a capture-pending flag and an overcapture flag."},{"name":"Output compare unit","description":"Sets, clears or toggles an output pin when the timer count matches a programmed value, keeping a compare register, an action-mode register and the output pin latch."},{"name":"One-shot monostable timer","description":"Emits a single pulse of programmable width after a trigger and then idles until retriggered, keeping a width register, a pulse-length counter, an armed flag and a retrigger-enable bit."},{"name":"Auto-reload timer with preload","description":"Counts to a period value and reloads, with new period and compare values staged in shadow registers that are copied in only at the update event, keeping the active counter, active period, shadow period and an update-pending flag."},{"name":"System tick timer","description":"Generates a periodic OS scheduler interrupt by counting down from a reload value, keeping a current-value register, a reload register, a control/enable register and a sticky count-flag."},{"name":"Timer event queue","description":"Holds several software-programmed absolute deadlines and fires an event when the free-running time reaches the earliest, keeping a deadline array, per-entry valid bits and a register for the current earliest-deadline index."},{"name":"Hierarchical timing wheel","description":"Schedules many timeouts in coarse and fine slot rings advanced by a tick, keeping per-level slot pointers, slot occupancy bitmaps and per-slot timer list head registers."},{"name":"Pulse-width measurement unit","description":"Measures the high time and period of an incoming digital waveform, keeping a running edge-to-edge counter, a captured high-time register, a captured period register and a measurement-ready flag."},{"name":"Missing-pulse detector","description":"Restarts a timeout counter on every input pulse and raises an alarm if the next pulse does not arrive in time, keeping a timeout register, a retriggerable counter and a missing-pulse alarm flag."},{"name":"Bus transaction timeout monitor","description":"Times each outstanding bus request and aborts it with an error
