candidates.description: Counts down from a reload value and flags a fault if it is serviced either too late or too early, keeping a down-counter, a window-open threshold register, a reload register and an early/late fault status register.

candidates.name: Center-aligned PWM generator
candidates.description: Drives a counter that ramps up then down each period and toggles the output on compare matches in both directions, keeping an up/down counter, a direction bit, a period register and a compare register.

candidates.name: Dead-time complementary PWM
candidates.description: Produces a high-side and low-side output pair from one PWM signal with programmable blanking gaps at each edge, keeping rising and falling dead-time registers, a dead-time countdown counter and the two output state flops.

candidates.name: Input capture unit
candidates.description: Latches the free-running timer value when a selected edge appears on an input pin, keeping an edge-select register, a capture register, a capture-pending flag and an overcapture flag.

candidates.name: Output compare unit
candidates.description: Sets, clears or toggles an output pin when the timer count matches a programmed value, keeping a compare register, an action-mode register and the output pin latch.

candidates.name: One-shot monostable timer
candidates.description: Emits a single pulse of programmable width after a trigger and then idles until retriggered, keeping a width register, a pulse-length counter, an armed flag and a retrigger-enable bit.

candidates.name: Auto-reload timer with preload
candidates.description: Counts to a period value and reloads, with new period and compare values staged in shadow registers that are copied in only at the update event, keeping the active counter, active period, shadow period and an update-pending flag.

candidates.name: System tick timer
candidates.description: Generates a periodic OS scheduler interrupt by counting down from a reload value, keeping a current-value register, a reload register, a control/enable register and a sticky count-flag.

candidates.name: Timer event queue
candidates.description: Holds several software-programmed absolute deadlines and fires an event when the free-running time reaches the earliest, keeping a deadline array, per-entry valid bits and a register for the current earliest-deadline index.

candidates.name: Hierarchical timing wheel
candidates.description: Schedules many timeouts in coarse and fine slot rings advanced by a tick, keeping per-level slot pointers, slot occupancy bitmaps and per-slot timer list head registers.

candidates.name: Pulse-width measurement unit
candidates.description: Measures the high time and period of an incoming digital waveform, keeping a running edge-to-edge counter, a captured high-time register, a captured period register and a measurement-ready flag.

candidates.name: Missing-pulse detector
candidates.description: Restarts a timeout counter on every input pulse and raises an alarm if the next pulse does not arrive in time, keeping a timeout register, a retriggerable counter and a missing-pulse alarm flag.

candidates.name: Bus transaction timeout monitor
candidates.description: Times each outstanding bus request and aborts it with an error response if it stalls too long, keeping a per-request elapsed-cycle counter, a timeout limit register and an error status register.

candidates.name: Spread-spectrum PWM
candidates.description: Randomly varies the PWM period around a nominal value to spread emitted EMI energy, keeping a period counter, a base-period register, a pseudo-random dither generator state and a dither-depth register.

candidates.name: Dithered high-resolution PWM
candidates.description: Achieves finer-than-clock duty resolution by alternating the duty between adjacent integer values across periods, keeping a period counter, an integer duty register, a fractional duty register and a fractional error accumulator.

candidates.name: Pulse-train burst generator
candidates.description: Emits a programmed count of pulses at a set spacing after a trigger and then stops, keeping a pulse-count register, a remaining-pulses counter, a spacing counter and a running flag.

candidates.name: Programmable delay pulse generator
candidates.description: Outputs a pulse of programmed width starting a programmed delay after an input trigger, keeping a delay register, a width register, a phase counter and a delay/width/idle phase register.

candidates.name: Multi-phase interleaved PWM
candidates.description: Generates several PWM channels sharing one period but each shifted by a programmable phase offset, keeping a master period counter, per-channel phase-offset registers and per-channel duty registers.

candidates.name: PWM fault trip latch
candidates.description: Forces PWM outputs to a safe state on an external fault input and holds them there until software clears it, keeping a fault latch, a safe-state output pattern register and a fault-clear/rearm control register.

candidates.name: Servo pulse generator
candidates.description: Produces fixed-rate control pulses whose width encodes a hobby-servo target position, keeping a frame counter, a position-to-width register and a pulse-active flag.

candidates.name: LED breathing engine
candidates.description: Smoothly ramps a PWM duty value up and down to fade an LED, keeping a PWM counter, a current-duty register, a ramp-step register, a ramp-rate prescale counter and a ramp-direction bit.

candidates.name: Gated event counter
candidates.description: Counts external input edges only while a gate input is asserted and latches the total when the gate closes, keeping an edge counter, a gate-state flop and a latched-result register.

candidates.name: Stopwatch lap timer
candidates.description: Runs an elapsed-time counter that can be started, stopped and sampled for split times without halting, keeping a running counter, a run/stop flag and a lap-capture register.

candidates.name: Low-power wake-up timer
candidates.description: Runs on an always-on slow clock while the system sleeps and asserts a wake request when its count reaches a programmed value, keeping a slow-clock counter, a wake-compare register and a wake-pending flag.

candidates.name: CRC residue checker
candidates.description: Runs received data and its appended CRC through a feedback shift register and flags an error at end of frame, keeping the running remainder register and a frame-done/error flag.

candidates.name: Table-driven parallel CRC engine
candidates.description: Updates a CRC several bytes per cycle by indexing precomputed lookup ROMs with the current remainder XORed with incoming data, holding the remainder register and the lookup tables.

candidates.name: Fletcher checksum unit
candidates.description: Computes a Fletcher checksum over a byte stream using two modular running-sum registers that are updated on every input word.

candidates.name: Adler-32 checksum unit
candidates.description: Computes an Adler-32 value with two modulo-65521 accumulator registers and a block counter that schedules deferred modular reductions.

candidates.name: Reed-Solomon syndrome calculator
candidates.description: Evaluates the received codeword at each root of the generator polynomial using a bank of Horner-rule GF multiply-accumulate registers, one per syndrome.

candidates.name: Berlekamp-Massey solver
candidates.description: Iteratively derives the error-locator polynomial from syndromes, keeping coefficient registers for the current and previous locator polynomials, a discrepancy register and a length/step counter.

candidates.name: Chien search unit
candidates.description: Tests every field element as a root of the error-locator polynomial by stepping per-coefficient GF multiplier registers each cycle and recording root positions in a position counter and hit flags.

candidates.name: Forney error evaluator
candidates.description: Computes error magnitudes at located positions from the error-evaluator polynomial and locator derivative, holding polynomial coefficient registers and a pending-correction output register.

candidates.name: BCH encoder
candidates.description: Generates binary BCH parity bits by dividing the message by a generator polynomial in a linear feedback shift register that holds the partial remainder.

candidates.name: Golay code encoder/decoder
candidates.description: Encodes 12-bit words into 24-bit extended Golay codewords and corrects up to three bit errors via syndrome lookup, keeping a syndrome register and a decode lookup table.

candidates.name: LDPC check-node processor
candidates.description: Computes min-sum check-to-variable messages for one parity-check row, storing the running minimum, second minimum, minimum index and sign-product registers.

candidates.name: LDPC variable-node processor
candidates.description: Sums channel log-likelihoods with incoming check messages to produce updated beliefs and hard decisions, keeping a per-node LLR memory and a posterior accumulator.

candidates.name: Viterbi branch metric unit
candidates.description: Computes Hamming or Euclidean distances between received soft symbols and each possible encoder output, latching the metrics in a branch-metric register bank.

candidates.name: Viterbi traceback unit
candidates.description: Walks backward through stored survivor decision bits from a chosen state to output decoded bits, holding a survivor-path memory, a traceback state register and a read pointer.

candidates.name: Turbo SISO decoder
candidates.description: Runs the max-log-MAP forward and backward recursions over a trellis to produce extrinsic information, storing alpha state-metric memory, beta registers and an extrinsic LLR buffer.

candidates.name: Polar successive-cancellation decoder
candidates.description: Decodes polar codes by traversing a binary tree of f/g LLR operations, keeping an LLR memory per tree stage, partial-sum registers and a frozen-bit mask ROM.

candidates.name: Convolutional interleaver
candidates.description: Spreads burst errors by delaying successive symbols through branches of increasing length, implemented with per-branch delay memories and a commutator branch counter.

candidates.name: Memory scrubber
candidates.description: Periodically reads each memory word through the ECC decoder and writes back corrected data, keeping a scrub address counter, an interval timer and a corrected-error count.

candidates.name: ECC error logger
candidates.description: Captures details of detected memory errors for software, holding syndrome, failing-address and error-type capture registers plus correctable and uncorrectable error counters.

candidates.name: Two-dimensional parity checker
candidates.description: Computes row and column parity over a data block to locate and flip a single erroneous bit, keeping a row-parity register and a column-parity accumulator register.

candidates.name: Chipkill symbol-correcting decoder
candidates.description: Corrects failure of an entire DRAM device by treating each chip's bits as one symbol of a symbol-based code, keeping a syndrome register and a failed-chip identifier register.

candidates.name: RAID-6 P+Q parity engine
candidates.description: Generates XOR parity P and Galois-field weighted parity Q across data stripes to tolerate two erasures, holding P and Q accumulator buffers and a stripe-index counter.

candidates.name: ARQ retransmission controller
candidates.description: Retransmits frames whose integrity check failed or were not acknowledged, keeping a retransmit buffer, sequence-number registers, a retry counter and an acknowledgment timer.

candidates.name: Lockstep duplicate-and-compare checker
candidates.description: Runs two copies of a logic block on the same inputs and raises a fault on any output mismatch, keeping a registered mismatch flag and a sticky error-status register.

candidates.name: Residue-code arithmetic checker
candidates.description: Checks adder or multiplier results by computing a mod-3 residue of the operands and result in parallel, holding operand residue registers and a residue-mismatch flag.

candidates.name: Composite-field AES S-box
candidates.description: Computes the AES SubBytes substitution by mapping bytes into GF((2^4)^2), inverting there and mapping back with the affine transform, optionally keeping pipeline registers between the isomorphism, inversion and output stages.

candidates.name: GHASH multiplier
candidates.description: Performs the GF(2^128) multiply-and-accumulate used for AES-GCM authentication, holding the hash subkey H and the running 128-bit tag accumulator.

candidates.name: XTS tweak generator
candidates.description: Produces per-block tweaks for AES-XTS storage encryption by repeatedly multiplying an encrypted sector tweak by alpha in GF(2^128), keeping the current tweak value and a block index register.

candidates.name: CBC chaining controller
candidates.description: Wraps a block cipher core to implement CBC encryption and decryption by XORing data with the previous ciphertext, storing the IV/chaining register and a mode/direction register.

candidates.name: CTR counter-block generator
candidates.description: Builds successive counter blocks from a nonce and an incrementing counter for counter-mode keystream generation, holding the nonce register, the counter register and a keystream buffer.

candidates.name: Keccak-f permutation core
candidates.description: Executes the theta, rho, pi, chi and iota steps of the Keccak-f[1600] permutation for SHA-3 and SHAKE, keeping the 5x5 lane state array and a round index counter.

candidates.name: Sponge absorb/squeeze controller
candidates.description: Manages rate-sized absorption of message blocks into a sponge state and later squeezing of output, tracking the byte offset within the rate, the domain-separation suffix and an absorb/squeeze phase register.

candidates.name: SHA-2 message schedule expander
candidates.description: Generates the per-round message words for SHA-256 from the input block using the sigma functions, keeping a sliding window of the 16 most recent schedule words.

candidates.name: Hash padding unit
candidates.description: Appends the Merkle-Damgard padding bit, zero fill and big-endian message length to the final message block, keeping a 64- or 128-bit total-length counter and a byte-position register.

candidates.name: HMAC sequencer
candidates.description: Drives an underlying hash core through the inner and outer passes of HMAC with ipad/opad-XORed keys, storing the padded key, the inner digest and a pass-phase register.

candidates.name: MD5 round core
candidates.description: Computes the 64 MD5 operations over a 512-bit block using the F, G, H, I functions and per-step constants, holding the four 32-bit chaining variables and a step counter.

candidates.name: DES Feistel round unit
candidates.description: Performs DES/3DES rounds with expansion, S-box substitution and P-permutation on the right half, keeping left and right half registers, the rotating C/D key halves and a round counter.

candidates.name: SM4 round unit
candidates.description: Executes the 32 unbalanced-Feistel rounds of the SM4 block cipher with its nonlinear tau and linear L transforms, holding four 32-bit word registers and the round-key schedule state.

candidates.name: BLAKE2 G-function core
candidates.description: Applies the BLAKE2 mixing function across columns and diagonals of the 4x4 working vector with permuted message words, storing the working vector, chaining value and byte offset counter.

candidates.name: Trivium stream cipher core
candidates.description: Generates keystream bits from three coupled nonlinear shift registers totaling 288 bits, holding that register state and a warm-up cycle counter used during initialization.

candidates.name: Poly1305 accumulator
candidates.description: Computes the Poly1305 one-time MAC by adding message blocks to an accumulator and multiplying by the clamped key r modulo 2^130-5, keeping the r and s key registers and the 130-bit accumulator.

candidates.name: Elliptic-curve point adder/doubler
candidates.description: Performs point addition and doubling in projective or Jacobian coordinates by sequencing field multiplications and additions, holding the X, Y, Z coordinate registers of the operands and temporaries.

candidates.name: Montgomery ladder scalar multiplier
candidates.description: Computes elliptic-curve scalar multiplication by scanning scalar bits and performing a uniform add-and-double step each bit, keeping the two ladder point registers, the scalar register and a bit-index counter.

candidates.name: RSA CRT recombination unit
candidates.description: Combines the two half-size exponentiation results modulo p and q into the full RSA result using Garner's formula, storing the partial results, the qInv coefficient and an output register.

candidates.name: NTT butterfly unit
candidates.description: Performs Cooley-Tukey/Gentleman-Sande butterflies modulo a small prime for lattice-based post-quantum schemes such as Kyber and Dilithium, holding coefficient operand registers, the current twiddle factor and stage/index counters.

candidates.name: TRNG health-test monitor
candidates.description: Runs continuous repetition-count and adaptive-proportion tests on raw entropy samples, keeping the last sample, a repeat counter, a window sample counter and an alarm flag.

candidates.name: Von Neumann debiaser
candidates.description: Removes bias from a raw random bitstream by examining non-overlapping bit pairs and emitting one bit for each unequal pair, storing the pending first bit of a pair and an output-valid flag.

candidates.name: CTR_DRBG state engine
candidates.description: Implements the NIST SP 800-90A counter-mode deterministic random bit generator with instantiate, reseed and generate operations, holding the internal key, the V counter block and a reseed counter.

candidates.name: Secure key slot vault
candidates.description: Stores cryptographic keys in a bank of write-only slots that feed cipher cores directly without software readback, keeping per-slot key registers, usage-permission bits and sticky lock bits.

candidates.name: Halfband interpolator
candidates.description: Doubles the sample rate by inserting filtered samples with a symmetric halfband FIR that skips its zero-valued taps, holding a tapped delay line of past inputs and a phase bit that selects the output branch.

candidates.name: Lattice filter
candidates.description: Filters a stream through cascaded lattice stages, each combining forward and backward prediction errors using reflection coefficients, and stores a backward-error delay register per stage plus a coefficient register file.

candidates.name: LMS adaptive filter
candidates.description: Runs an FIR filter whose taps are updated every sample from the product of the error signal, the step size and the delayed input, keeping an input delay line, a tap-weight register array and the latest error value.

candidates.name: Goertzel tone detector
candidates.description: Measures the energy of one frequency bin over a block of samples with a second-order recursion, keeping two state registers, a sample counter and a coefficient register.

candidates.name: Hilbert transformer
candidates.description: Produces a 90-degree phase-shifted quadrature copy of a real input with an antisymmetric FIR, holding a delay line of input samples and a matched delay that aligns the in-phase output.

candidates.name: Complex digital mixer
candidates.description: Multiplies incoming I/Q samples by a complex local-oscillator sample to shift the signal in frequency, holding pipeline registers for the four partial products and the summed outputs.

candidates.name: DC-blocking filter
candidates.description: Removes the DC offset from a stream with a first-order high-pass recursion, keeping the previous input sample and the previous output sample in registers.

candidates.name: Farrow fractional-delay interpolator
candidates.description: Produces samples at arbitrary fractional positions by evaluating a polynomial in the fractional delay over sub-filter outputs, keeping a shared input delay line, the sub-filter output registers and a fractional-mu register.

candidates.name: Costas loop phase discriminator
candidates.description: Estimates the carrier phase error from derotated I/Q samples using sign-and-multiply products for carrier recovery, keeping the last derotated sample pair and a registered error output.

candidates.name: Gardner timing error detector
candidates.description: Computes a symbol-timing error from the current and previous symbol samples and the midpoint sample between them, storing those samples in a small history register set and a strobe phase flag.

candidates.name: Sliding DFT bin
candidates.description: Updates one DFT bin on every new sample by adding the newest sample, subtracting the oldest and applying a complex twiddle rotation, keeping an N-deep sample history buffer and a complex bin accumulator.

candidates.name: R2SDF FFT stage
candidates.description: Performs one stage of a pipelined radix-2 single-delay-feedback FFT, routing samples through a feedback delay memory into a butterfly, with a stage control counter that toggles between fill and compute modes.

candidates.name: Alpha-max-beta-min magnitude estimator
candidates.description: Approximates the magnitude of a complex sample by taking the larger and smaller absolute components and combining them with fixed weights, holding registered absolute values and the estimate.

candidates.name: RMS power meter
candidates.description: Measures signal power by squaring samples, accumulating them over a programmable window and outputting the mean square or its root, keeping a sum-of-squares accumulator, a window counter and a result register.

candidates.name: Exponential moving-average filter
candidates.description: Smooths a stream with a leaky integrator that adds a shifted fraction of the difference between the input and the current average, keeping a single extended-precision average register and a shift-amount setting.

candidates.name: Feedback comb filter
candidates.description: Creates echo or resonance by adding a scaled, delayed copy of the output back to the input, keeping a circular delay memory, its write pointer and a feedback gain register.

candidates.name: Schroeder allpass section
candidates.description: Disperses phase without changing magnitude, as used in reverberators, by combining feedforward and feedback paths around a long delay, keeping a circular delay buffer, a pointer and a gain coefficient.

candidates.name: TPDF dither generator
candidates.description: Adds triangular-probability noise, formed from two pseudo-random values, to samples before word-length reduction, keeping the two random generator states and a registered dithered output.

candidates.name: Overlap-add block convolver
candidates.description: Convolves a long stream with a filter by processing input blocks and summing the overlapping tail of each block result into the next, keeping a block input buffer, an overlap tail memory and a block counter.

candidates.name: Zero-crossing pitch estimator
candidates.description: Estimates the fundamental period of a signal by timing the intervals between sign changes, keeping the previous sample sign, a running interval counter and the last measured period register.

candidates.name: IQ imbalance corrector
candidates.description: Compensates gain and phase mismatch between the I and Q branches by applying a correction matrix to each complex sample, holding programmable gain and phase coefficients and pipelined corrected outputs.

candidates.name: Constellation slicer
candidates.description: Maps each received complex symbol to the nearest constellation point and outputs the decided bits plus the decision error vector, holding the configured modulation order and registered decision and error values.

candidates.name: Welch spectral averager
candidates.description: Averages power spectra across successive FFT frames by accumulating squared bin magnitudes in per-bin memory, keeping the bin accumulation RAM, a bin index counter and a frame counter.

candidates.name: Dynamic range compressor
candidates.description: Reduces audio dynamic range by tracking the signal envelope and applying a gain reduction above a threshold with attack and release smoothing, keeping an envelope register, a current gain register and the threshold and ratio parameters.

candidates.name: Distributed arithmetic filter
candidates.description: Implements a multiplierless FIR by shifting input samples out bit-serially, using each bit-slice to address a precomputed coefficient-sum lookup table and shift-accumulating the results, keeping input shift registers, the coefficient-sum ROM, an accumulator and a bit counter.

candidates.name: Tournament branch predictor
candidates.description: Combines a local-history predictor and a global-history predictor through a chooser table of saturating counters that selects which component's prediction to use, keeping a local history table, two pattern tables and the chooser array.

candidates.name: TAGE branch predictor
candidates.description: Predicts branch direction from several tagged tables indexed by geometrically increasing global-history lengths, keeping per-entry tags, prediction counters, usefulness bits and a base bimodal table.

candidates.name: Perceptron branch predictor
candidates.description: Computes a dot product of signed weights with global history bits to predict a branch and trains the weights on mispredictions, keeping a table of weight vectors and a history register.

candidates.name: Loop predictor
candidates.description: Recognizes branches that close fixed-trip-count loops and predicts the exit iteration, keeping per-entry tags, learned trip counts, current iteration counts and confidence counters.

candidates.name: Indirect target predictor
candidates.description: Predicts targets of register-indirect jumps by hashing the branch address with path history into a tagged target table, keeping target addresses, tags and a path-history register.

candidates.name: Speculative history checkpoint unit
candidates.description: Updates the global branch history speculatively at prediction time and restores it on misprediction, keeping the speculative history register and a set of per-branch history snapshots.

candidates.name: Fetch target queue
candidates.description: Decouples the branch predictor from the instruction cache by queuing predicted fetch blocks, keeping per-entry start addresses, predicted targets and branch metadata for later resolution.

candidates.name: Next-line predictor
candidates.description: Provides a single-cycle guess of the next fetch address and way from the current fetch line, keeping a small table of next-line indices, way hints and valid bits.

candidates.name: Compressed instruction expander
candidates.description: Translates 16-bit compressed instruction encodings into their equivalent 32-bit forms ahead of decode, keeping a halfword holding register for instructions that straddle fetch boundaries.

candidates.name: Instruction length decoder
candidates.description: Scans a byte stream of variable-length instructions to mark instruction boundaries and extract aligned instructions, keeping a byte buffer, boundary marker bits and a carry-over offset register.

candidates.name: Macro-op fusion unit
candidates.description: Detects adjacent instruction pairs such as compare-and-branch and merges them into one internal operation, keeping a lookahead slot holding the previous decoded instruction.

candidates.name: Loop stream buffer
candidates.description: Captures the decoded instructions of a small tight loop and replays them without refetching, keeping an instruction buffer, loop start and end pointers and a replay-active flag.

candidates.name: Branch mask allocator
candidates.description: Assigns each in-flight speculative branch a tag bit and broadcasts kill or clear signals when branches resolve, keeping a free-tag vector and per-instruction branch dependency masks.

candidates.name: Age matrix selector
candidates.description: Picks the oldest ready instruction among issue queue entries using a pairwise older-than bit matrix, keeping the age matrix and per-entry ready bits.

candidates.name: Dependency matrix wakeup unit
candidates.description: Wakes waiting instructions when their producers issue by consulting a matrix of producer-consumer dependency bits, keeping the dependency matrix and per-entry pending-source flags.

candidates.name: Register busy-bit table
candidates.description: Tracks for each physical or architectural register whether its value is still being produced, keeping one busy bit per register that is set at dispatch and cleared at writeback.

candidates.name: Store-set dependence predictor
candidates.description: Predicts which loads depend on which earlier stores so loads can issue speculatively but wait on likely conflicts, keeping a store-set ID table and a last-fetched-store table.

candidates.name: Load replay unit
candidates.description: Re-issues loads and their dependents when a speculative cache-hit assumption or memory ordering check fails, keeping a replay queue of instruction tags and replay-reason codes.

candidates.name: Branch resolution unit
candidates.description: Evaluates branch conditions and targets in execute, compares them with the prediction and triggers redirect and flush, keeping the predicted target, prediction metadata and a redirect address register.

candidates.name: Value predictor
candidates.description: Predicts the result of long-latency instructions such as loads from their prior outcomes, keeping a table of last values, strides and confidence counters indexed by instruction address.

candidates.name: Fine-grained thread scheduler
candidates.description: Selects one hardware thread per cycle to fetch or issue in an interleaved multithreaded pipeline, keeping per-thread program counters, ready flags and a rotating selection pointer.

candidates.name: Zero-overhead loop controller
candidates.description: Executes hardware loops without branch instructions by redirecting fetch at the loop end address, keeping loop start, loop end and iteration count registers for each nesting level.

candidates.name: LL/SC reservation monitor
candidates.description: Supports load-linked and store-conditional atomics by recording a reserved address and clearing it on intervening writes, keeping a reservation address register and a reservation-valid flag.

candidates.name: Writeback port arbiter
candidates.description: Schedules which completing functional units may use the limited register-file write ports in each cycle, keeping a result-bus reservation shift register of booked future writeback slots.
